_meta.description: HUD/IRS Multifamily Tax Subsidy Project (MTSP) income limits, FY2026, for Allegheny County / the Pittsburgh, PA HUD area. These are the standard thresholds used to qualify tenants and restrict rents under the Low-Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) program (see 'Building Affordable Housing', a Pro-Housing Pittsburgh talk by James Eash of Action Housing, on the common use of a 60% AMI ceiling). Used only to show what income a given rent implies relative to these limits; never used to set or adjust the Development Ease Score.
_meta.source: HUD USER, FY2026 Multifamily Tax Subsidy Project (MTSP) Income Limits
_meta.areaName: Pittsburgh, PA HUD Metro FMR Area
_meta.unit: dollars per year, gross household income, by household size (persons)
_meta.columns: 50 = Very Low Income (50% AMI); 60 = the common LIHTC rent-restriction ceiling (60% AMI)
